technique_name: Explain how the ancient philosopher Plato's philosophy should be applied in the context of modern times.
description: Plato's philosophy can be applied to modern times in a variety of ways. One of the key elements of his philosophy is the idea of justice, which suggests that the world should be organized in such a way that those with the skills, resources, and interests necessary to benefit society can do so, for the good of all.
